'''Snowblind Mews''' was a street located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the only access route available to anyone wishing to enter [[Poloda Place]], an apartment building.<ref name="sos">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
